AGENDA
  GLENDALE AUDIT COMMITTEE
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING
  633 E. Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.
  APRIL 30, 2026 AT 2:00 PM

1.  ROLL CALL

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the April 30, 2026 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on April 23, 2026,
  on the bulletin board outside City Hall.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision.
   The Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on January 29, 2026.

5.  ACTION ITEMS
  a. Consideration of Request to Agendize Discussion on Audit Committee Meeting Days
  and Times
  1. Motion to approve the request to agendize a discussion regarding the specific days and
  times for future Audit Committee meetings at the next regular meeting.
  b. Presentation and Discussion of 2026 Municipal Internal Audit Benchmarking Survey
  Results – Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor
  Motion to:
  1. Receive and file the 2026 Municipal Internal Audit Benchmarking Survey results;
  2. Discuss and provide feedback regarding the survey findings and the City’s current
  internal audit delivery model.

6.  REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of March 31, 2026 – Natalie Minami-Valdivia,
  Principal Internal Auditor

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS

8.  NEW BUSINESS

9.  ADJOURNMENT

CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  April 30, 2026

1.  ROLL CALL: 2:05 PM

  Present:  Zareh Davidian, Jack Mavyan, Denise Miller, Christopher
  Satoorian, Alex Parajon

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:

  a. Posting of Agenda

  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of April 30, 2026, was posted
  on April 23, 2026, on the bulletin board outside City Hall.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  Speaker:  None

  Two handouts were provided by Herbert Molano as part of public comment.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on January 29, 2026

  Moved:  Davidian  Seconded:  Mavyan

  Action: Vote as follows:

  Ayes: Zareh Davidian, Jack Mavyan, Christopher Satoorian, Alex Parajon
  Noes: None
  Absent: None
  Abstain: Denise Miller

  1
 5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  a. Consideration of Request to Agendize Discussion on Audit Committee
  Meeting Days and Times

  Chair Parajon introduced the item. The Committee discussed scheduling
  preferences. Multiple members expressed that morning meetings are not
  viable due to work conflicts.

  Following discussion, the Committee reached a consensus to keep the
  regular meeting time at 2:00 PM and declined to agendize further discussion
  for the next regular meeting. No action was taken.

  b. Presentation and Discussion of 2026 Municipal Internal Audit
  Benchmarking Survey Results – Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Principal
  Internal Auditor

  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor, presented the 2026
  Municipal Internal Audit Benchmarking survey results. Ms. Minami-Valdivia
  and Assistant City Manager John Takhtalian answered questions from the
  committee members.

  Committee made note of the 2026 Municipal Internal Audit Benchmarking
  survey. No action was taken.

  Speaker: Herbert Molano, Ani Khash

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of March 31, 2026 – Natalie Minami-
  Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor

  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor, provided a report to
  the Audit Committee on the Internal Audit activity for the quarter ended on
  March 31, 2025. She covered projects in progress, continuous audits,
  quarterly follow-up status on outstanding audit issues, and advisory services
  and answered questions from the Committee members.

  Committee Member Denise Miller requested that staff prepare and bring back
  a staff report at the next scheduled meeting regarding leveraging AI in the
  field of auditing.

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  None.

  2
 8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  None.

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Adjournment at 3:17 PM

  3
